en.title: Longest Contiguous Same-Speed Group After Removing At Most k Racers
en.description:
Remove at most k racers; everyone else keeps their original relative order. Find the maximum number of people in a contiguous same-speed segment of the remaining line. Output the number of people who stay in that segment, not counting removed racers.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n k and the second line contains speed. The original statement gives no value bounds; on this site 1≤n≤200000, 0≤k≤n, 1≤speed[i]≤10^9. The original index typo "0 to n" is unified as 0..n−1 for n items.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The answers are 2, 2 and 1 respectively. In the first example, removing only one 2 is still not enough to connect the three 1s.
hints: Collect the positions p of each speed separately. Run two pointers over that position array, keeping p[r]−p[l]−(r−l)≤k, and update the same-speed count r−l+1.
